exposure: Third and fourth degree anal sphincter tears
outcome: third and fourth degree anal sphincter tears
cohort: Primigravid women delivering at term in the years 2010-2015 in six Sydney public teaching hospitals and six adjacent Sydney private hospitals
finding: Passive management of labor instituted in Sydney public hospitals by government directive seems to be associated with a higher rate of obstetric anal sphincter injuries than was observed with active management.
mod_finding: Passive management of labor in Sydney public hospitals was associated with a higher rate of third and fourth degree anal sphincter tears compared to active management in private hospitals.
